channel.title: Rwanda - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Rwanda, every source cited.

item.title: RPF youth meet in Poland to discuss development
item.description: RPF Secretary General Christophe Bazivamo urged young members in Europe to take practical action for Rwanda's development.

item.title: African Cup of Nations reverts to two-year cycle
item.description: Confederation of African Football reverses decision to hold tournament every four years.

item.title: New Auditor General urged to close Rwanda audit gap
item.description: Senators want new Auditor General to investigate why public institutions ignore audit recommendations.

item.title: Rwanda says DRC unmet security commitments
item.description: Kigali accuses Kinshasa of failing to neutralize the FDLR militia group as per Washington Accords.
